title: Brush Kind Suggestion Percentages
description: Add per-kind suggestion percentage sliders (node/object and handle/vortex groups each sum to 1 with proportional renorm). When brush is active, weighted-random re-order brush suggestion candidates in puzzle 2D and 3D.
summary: Added per-kind suggestion percentage sliders (node/object and handle/vortex groups, each summing to 1 with proportional renorm) on window measures for puzzle 2D and 3D play. Shared helpers in @framework/core: uniformKindWeights, normalizeKindWeightGroup, syncKindWeightMap, weightedOrder. 2D WASM: brush_node/handle kind weights, setBrushKindWeights, weighted candidate ordering and weighted target-handle pick. Playground host wires catalogs and weight sync to renderer. 3D: weightedOrderBrushCompatibleCandidates with object×vortex weights in BrushSession.
